entities.name: LRG1
observations: In ER-positive/luminal breast cancer, LRG1 mRNA was higher in PIK3CA-mutant than PIK3CA-wild-type tumors in two datasets; evidence concerns transcript expression.
In a 25-patient neoadjuvant letrozole dataset, LRG1 mRNA decreased after aromatase-inhibitor treatment.

In 84 ER-positive metastatic patients treated first-line with aromatase inhibitors, LRG1 expression was associated with overall survival and progression-free survival; PFS association remained after adjustment for traditional predictive factors.

entities.name: PIK3CA
observations: PIK3CA exon 9/20 mutation status was compared with transcript profiles in luminal breast cancer; LRG1 expression was higher in mutant tumors than wild type.

entities.name: Breast cancer
observations: The direct evidence concerns ER-positive/luminal breast cancer, including TCGA luminal tumors and metastatic breast-cancer patients receiving first-line aromatase inhibitors.

entities.name: Letrozole
observations: In a 25-patient neoadjuvant breast-cancer dataset, LRG1 mRNA decreased in paired biopsies after letrozole treatment.

entities.name: PMID:27491861
observations: Original 2016 Molecular Oncology study analyzing LRG1 mRNA, PIK3CA genotype, and aromatase-inhibitor outcomes in breast cancer.
Analyzed 286 luminal TCGA tumors and 84 ER-positive metastatic primary tumors; exact LRG1-specific effect sizes and p-values were not available in the supplied abstract-level evidence.
